hard_findings.title: Mandatory source gates depend on assertions without rejecting optimization

rule.text: Actual HEAD/source/root/branch match; all tracked execution bytes equal exact Git blobs before and after.

hard_findings.title: Frozen interpreter and isolated prefix are not matched before verify

supporting_rule.text: Stage exact execution dependencies; reuse an appropriate verified environment or create an isolated one and keep shared environments stable.

hard_findings.impact: The runner checks only numpy/torch versions. Any environment with those two package versions can enter verify even when Python version or sys.prefix contradicts the frozen environment. Post-success sys.version/executable logging does not enforce the declared precondition.
hard_findings.requested_change: Before the one verify call, explicitly match the frozen Python version and actual sys.prefix/isolated environment, record actual interpreter identity in the start/evidence path, and reject mismatches without project execution.
